statements.text: Impression: left-sided lumbar radiculopathy secondary to L4-L5 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 08/10/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline VAS prior to any intervention: 82 mm.
Reports low back pain radiating to the left leg for 23 weeks.
PT discharge summary: completed 4 weeks of physical therapy (04/03/2026 to 05/01/2026) without meaningful improvement; ibuprofen 600 mg TID for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Denies fever, chills, weight loss, or bowel or bladder changes; no history of cancer.
Epidural steroid injection history: 1 lumbar injection in the past 12 months (03/06/2026).
Pt reports onset of the radiating pain only 1 week ago.
